data.gender_notes: Khoorsheeda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Khoorsheeda (خرشيدة) translates to 'Lady of the garden'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'khorsh', which means 'garden', and the suffix '-eeda', which denotes 'lady'. The name is often used for girls in Arabic, Urdu, and Persian cultures. The name Khoorsheeda carries the meaning “Lady of the garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khoorsheeda usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
